THE EVERYDAY AI CHALLENGE

So many tools. So many possibilities.
Where do you start?

AI can be useful, but knowing how to apply it to the work in front of you is a different skill.

⌕

Too many tools

New AI products appear constantly, making it hard to know which tool fits your task.

✎

Unclear prompts

You know what you need, but struggle to turn that idea into useful instructions.

◌

Answers need checking

AI output can be incomplete or incorrect, so it still needs your judgement and verification.

⟳

No repeatable system

Trying tools once is easy. Turning useful tasks into dependable workflows takes practice.

✦

PRACTICA gives you a structured starting point. Understand the basics, explore useful tools, practise better prompts and connect everyday tasks into workflows you can refine.
